title: Philippines imported 4 GW of Chinese solar panels in January-April
content:

title: Swiss power distributor allowed to remunerate solar power at market rates
content:
Switzerland will allow grid operators to remunerate photovoltaic electricity at real-time market prices from 2027, aiming to better align solar feed-in with demand. Small PV systems will be protected by a minimum remuneration premium, while storage and local consumption are expected to become more important under the new model.

title: German consortium developing aluminum facade elements with integrated PV modules
content:
A group of German companies and research institutes has developed a PV-integrated aluminum façade element using direct lamination of solar modules onto 3D-shaped metal structures. The system achieves conventional module-level performance and safety while offering high design flexibility, scalability, and improved architectural acceptance for building-integrated photovoltaics.

title: Romania tightens grid connection rules for future projects
content:
Romania is increasing the financial guarantee required to obtain a grid connection permit and bringing in an authorization guarantee for construction in a bid to curb speculative projects and create more realistic pipelines.

title: EU Roundup: TagEnergy, Iberdrola commission France and Spain’s largest batteries, construction launched elsewhere
content: TagEnergy has commissioned a 240MW/480MWh project in France while Iberdrola has done the same with a 58MW/120MWh system in Spain, the two largest projects in each country. Meanwhile Engie, ACL Energy and Chint Solar Europe have moved to construction on projects in Belgium, Italy and Germany.

title: HyperStrong signs deal to supply battery storage project selected in Malaysia government tender
